AboutSection.desc: Hello! 🙋‍♂️ I am a student from China, currently studying in Chengdu 📚. I love programming 💻, familiar with Python and web development. You can visit my blog 🌐 via the button above to learn more about my story and tech articles. I love playing Minecraft 🎮 (IGN: Mystic_Stars), including Survival, Mini-games, and PVP. I'm also an anime lover 🌸. If you'd like to learn more, feel free to visit my Bilibili channel 📽️, GitHub profile 💾, or email me at 📮 ovo@ybovo.com.
